title: Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency: Test-Time Reasoning with Imperfect Generators and Verifiers
abstract: arXiv:2611.06606v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can solve many multi-step reasoning problems, but their reasoning remains brittle: plausible intermediate steps often lead to incorrect answers. Improving reasoning at test time requires balancing two imperfect signals: the generator, which provides diversity, and the verifier, which guides correctness. Existing approaches largely favor one side of this tradeoff. Verifier-weighted voting relies on trajectories sampled from the generator and cannot steer generation toward correct ones. By contrast, beam-style verifier-guided search can steer generation, but may over-concentrate on narrow trajectory sets and amplify verifier errors.   We propose Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency (VGSC), a stochastic decoding framework that combines step-level correctness and future-outcome estimates to guide reasoning during generation. translated_title: 验证器引导的自一致性：基于不完美生成器与验证器的测试时推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够解决许多多步推理问题，但其推理仍然脆弱：看似合理的中间步骤往往导致错误的答案。在测试时改进推理需要平衡两个不完美的信号：提供多样性的生成器，以及引导正确性的验证器。现有方法大多偏向这一权衡的某一侧。基于验证器加权的投票方法依赖于从生成器采样的轨迹，无法将生成过程引导向正确的方向；相比之下，束搜索式的验证器引导搜索虽然可以引导生成，但可能过度集中于狭窄的轨迹集合，并放大验证器的错误。我们提出了验证器引导的自一致性，这是一种随机解码框架，它结合步骤级正确性与未来结果估计来在生成过程中引导推理。VGSC反复从基础语言模型中提出候选的下一步，并利用这两种信号在……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出验证器引导的自一致性（VGSC）随机解码框架，在生成过程中同时利用步骤级正确性与未来结果估计两种信号，在不完美的生成器多样性与验证器正确性引导之间取得平衡，从而改进测试时推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency (VGSC), a stochastic decoding framework that combines step-level correctness and future-outcome estimates during generation, balancing the diversity of imperfect generators with the correctness guidance of imperfect verifiers to improve test-time reasoning.
